# Citeable

> Citeable (AREOS) is an automated Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) and AI search audit platform that analyzes websites for visibility across AI search engines and answer engines (ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews).

## About
Citeable evaluates websites across technical access, crawler policies, content extractability, factual density, and source citation authority. It combines deterministic technical diagnostics, human-in-the-loop qualitative reviews, and grounded LLM synthesis.
